name: ResizablePanels
summary: Two or more panels side by side or stacked, with dividers a person drags or moves with the keys to share the room. Sizes are percents, reported through onLayout for the app to save.
useWhen: An editor layout: a layers sidebar, the canvas and an inspector the person sizes to their task
A preview over a console or a log that the person makes taller or shorter
Two views compared side by side where the person decides the split
avoidWhen: A list and its detail that should stack on phones
A fixed page frame with a header, a sidebar and main content
Content that should simply wrap to the width it gets

orientation.description: horizontal: panels side by side, in reading order (the first on the right in Arabic). vertical: panels stacked. Sets data-orientation.

sizes.description: Controlled sizes in percent, one per panel, with onSizesChange.

defaultSizes.description: Starting sizes in percent. Default: each panel's defaultSize, the rest shared evenly. Pass the sizes saved from onLayout to restore a layout.

onSizesChange.description: Called on every change, while a drag runs too.

onLayout.description: Called with the settled sizes when a drag ends and after each key. The component keeps no storage.

step.description: The arrow key step in percent.

ResizablePanel.defaultSize.description: The starting size in percent when the group has no defaultSizes.

ResizablePanel.collapsible.description: The panel collapses when dragged past half its min, with Enter or a double click on a handle next to it. Sets data-collapsed.

ResizablePanel.collapsedSize.description: The collapsed size in percent. 0 hides the panel and makes its content inert; a few percent leaves a rail.

ResizableHandle.label.description: The name of the separator. Name the panel it resizes: Resize sidebar. Under lang="ar" the default is تغيير حجم الأقسام.

a11y.role: separator on each handle (the WAI-ARIA window splitter): focusable, aria-valuenow is the size of the panel before it in percent, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax its limits, aria-controls names that panel, aria-orientation is vertical in a horizontal group.
a11y.focus: Each handle is one tab stop, in reading order between its panels. A drag focuses the handle it moves.

keys.Tab: Moves to the next handle or the next control inside a panel
keys.ArrowLeft, ArrowRight: In a horizontal group, move the handle 5 percent left or right on screen. In Arabic the first panel is on the right, so ArrowLeft grows it. An arrow that grows a collapsed panel opens it at its last size.
keys.ArrowUp, ArrowDown: In a vertical group, move the handle 5 percent up or down
keys.Home: Moves the handle to its far start: the panel before it at its min
keys.End: Moves the handle to its far end: the panel before it at its max
keys.Enter: Collapses the collapsible panel next to the handle (the one before it first) and restores it to its last size

a11y.announce: The separator's value, the size of the panel before it in percent, after each key.
notes: Every drag has a key path (WCAG 2.5.7): the arrows, Home, End and Enter do all a drag does.
The handle line is 1px, its target is 24px (size.target-min) spread over both panels (WCAG 2.5.8).
A collapsed panel at size 0 is inert, so its controls leave the tab order and the accessibility tree.
Panels and handles must be direct children of ResizablePanels (fragments and arrays are fine): the group walks them in order.
Sizes are layout and never animate; under reduced motion nothing changes.

en.label: Resize plus the panel name, in sentence case: Resize sidebar, Resize inspector.

ar.label: Noun form, no diacritics: تغيير حجم الطبقات، تغيير حجم الخصائص.

angular.behavior: own: the shared resize math, cdk:bidi for the arrow direction

native.note: Phones show one pane at a time. Tablets use SplitView, which stacks or shows two panes by width.

styles.studio: A 1px subtle line between flat panels; the line turns strong on hover and takes the focus color while it drags or has focus, with a small pill grip.
styles.desk: The same hairline and grip on the Desk border tokens.
styles.neutral: The same parts on the Neutral border tokens once 1.10 lands.

mistakes.wrong: A divider that only moves with a pointer
mistakes.right: ResizableHandle moves with the arrows, Home, End and Enter

mistakes.wrong: Saving the layout to localStorage inside the component
mistakes.right: Save the sizes from onLayout in the app and pass them back as defaultSizes
The handle keeps a 1px line in a 24px target
Name the panel: Resize layers, Resize inspector
